grader.scenario: Parental control Content Shield stuck on 'Strict' blocking university medical research journals despite being toggled off in My S-Net
grader.notes: Exemplary 100% score call where Declan diagnoses a stuck RADIUS Content Shield policy attribute on the Belfast BNG. Tests three hard PASS cases: Empathy ([06:14] responding immediately when Aoife's sentiment drops from calm to -21.0 mid-call after a standard router DNS flush fails), Active Listening ([10:15] recalling exact URLs and error code CS-403-STRICT before and after flushing the BNG DNS table), and Ownership ([07:14]-[09:50] explaining the backend sync bug transparently while fixing the RADIUS profile himself).

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: [00:00] Agent: 'Good afternoon, thank you for calling S-Net Fibre Technical Support.' and [16:19] Agent: 'Thank you for choosing S-Net, and have a great rest of your day!'

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: [08:45] Agent announces hold ('Please bear with me for a moment while I rewrite your RADIUS profile...') and returns after 55s at [09:50] with 'Thank you for holding, Aoife.'

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: [00:29] Agent asks for billing address and four-digit security PIN; Customer verifies at [00:46].

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: [00:29], [01:57], [06:14], [16:19] Agent addresses Aoife by name throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [05:54] Customer expresses sharp frustration (-21.0 sentiment) when the initial router DNS flush fails ahead of her midnight thesis deadline; at [06:14] Agent immediately responds: 'I completely understand how frustrating that is when you have got a thesis deadline tonight, Aoife, and I am really sorry that first router DNS flush did not clear the block.'

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: [01:57] Agent: 'Let me make sure I have captured all the details accurately, Aoife: even though you toggled S-Net Content Shield to Off in your My S-Net dashboard yesterday evening and the portal still displays Off, your broadband line is still enforcing the Strict filter and blocking medical research journals like PubMed and The Lancet.'

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: [10:15] Agent recalls the exact domains (pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov and thelancet.com), redirect host (block.s-net.co.uk), and policy code (CS-403-STRICT) mentioned at [01:11] and [02:21] to compare before-and-after BNG DNS table flushing without asking Aoife to repeat them.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [07:14], [08:16], [09:50] Agent transparently explains the backend portal-to-RADIUS identity-sync bug to answer Aoife's question, while explicitly refusing to hand her off to a back-office queue and fixing the RADIUS attribute and BNG CoA session himself.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [06:50], [14:04], [16:19] Agent builds warm, encouraging rapport around Aoife's oncology dissertation and offers helpful device-level DNS advice.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: [01:28], [02:34], [03:08] Agent probes for when the toggle was changed, whether the block affects multiple devices/browsers vs mobile data, and whether the devices use default DHCP DNS and IPv6.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: [11:18]-[12:01] and [16:09] Customer confirms PubMed, The Lancet Oncology PDFs, and BMJ load immediately on both her MacBook Pro and iPad with the CS-403-STRICT block completely gone.
